advanced_mode.name: Advanced Mode
advanced_mode.description: ⚠️ **WARNING:** Disabling default_config components can break core functionality. Do your research before disabling integrations. If you experience problems, re-enable integrations or switch back to Basic mode.

data.enable_advanced_mode: I understand the risks, enable Advanced Mode.

data_description.mode_dropdown: Warning: No Default Config is enabled. Please add 'default_config_manager:' to configuration.yaml. [More information](https://github.com/earto/default_config_manager).

disclaimer.title: Advanced Mode Warning
disclaimer.description:
⚠️ **WARNING:** Advanced mode allows you to disable core components. Take care as misconfiguration can break core functionality and integrations. In the event of any problems, select Basic mode to restore factory behaviour. 

Please confirm if you want to proceed.

data.acknowledge: I understand the risks, enable Advanced Mode.

revert_basic.title: Change to Basic Mode
revert_basic.description:
You are changing back to Basic Mode. All standard default integrations will now be re-enabled and restored to factory state.

Click Submit to confirm or X to cancel.

error.must_acknowledge: You must check the box to confirm you understand the risks before saving.

missing_yaml.title: Missing Configuration
missing_yaml.description:
No Default Config is enabled.

To enable Default Config Manager, add 'default_config_manager:' to configuration.yaml then restart Home Assistant.

NOTE: This is required for factory startup behaviour. [More information](https://github.com/earto/default_config_manager).

standard_only.title: Incorrect Configuration
standard_only.description:
Standard Default Config is enabled.

To enable Default Config Manager, change 'default_config:' to 'default_config_manager:' in your configuration.yaml then restart Home Assistant.

NOTE: This is required for factory startup behaviour. [More information](https://github.com/earto/default_config_manager).

both_enabled.title: Incorrect Configuration
both_enabled.description:
Both Standard and Managed Default Configs are enabled.

Please remove the standard 'default_config:' from your configuration.yaml then restart Home Assistant.

NOTE: This is required for factory startup behaviour. [More information](https://github.com/earto/default_config_manager).

restart_required.title: Restart Required
restart_required.description: Changes to enabled integrations have been detected. Restart is required for changes to take effect.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: Are you sure you want to restart to apply changes?
